header.title: 10 Critical Threat Vectors Audited
header.subtitle: ShipSafe inspects the full surface of modern AI-generated codebases against the 10 most damaging vibe-coding security pitfalls:

vectors.name: SQL Injection
vectors.techDescription: Raw SQL string concatenation and unescaped template literal interpolations in database queries and ORMs.
vectors.consequence: Full database compromise, unauthorized extraction of sensitive user records, and catastrophic customer data leakage.

vectors.name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
vectors.techDescription: Unescaped HTML injections via innerHTML, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, or unvalidated document.write calls.
vectors.consequence: Session token hijacking, account takeover, and execution of malicious payload scripts in end-user browsers.

vectors.name: DDoS & ReDoS
vectors.techDescription: Endpoints missing rate limiting middleware coupled with catastrophic polynomial or exponential regex backtracking.
vectors.consequence: Application downtime, server CPU starvation, third-party API quota exhaustion, and runaway cloud infrastructure bills.

vectors.name: Brute Force & Timing Attacks
vectors.techDescription: Plaintext string equality comparisons for secrets without constant-time equality guards (crypto.timingSafeEqual).
vectors.consequence: Cryptographic secret deduction via side-channel timing analysis and successful automated credential brute-forcing.

vectors.name: Malware & Upload Web Shells
vectors.techDescription: Unvalidated multi-part file uploads allowing executable extensions (PHP/JSP/Node) and hidden web shell payloads.
vectors.consequence: Permanent server takeover, persistent unauthorized access, and root access exploitation by hostile actors.

vectors.name: MitM & Broken TLS
vectors.techDescription: Insecure HTTPS configurations such as rejectUnauthorized: false, plaintext credential transmission, and missing secure cookie attributes.
vectors.consequence: Man-in-the-middle network interception, plaintext token harvesting over public Wi-Fi, and session impersonation.

vectors.name: Phishing & Open Redirect
vectors.techDescription: Unvalidated external redirect query parameters and missing HTTP security headers (X-Frame-Options, Content-Security-Policy).
vectors.consequence: Weaponization of your official domain for phishing credential theft and clickjacking UI overlays.

vectors.name: Defacement Risks
vectors.techDescription: Unprotected public administrative endpoints or CMS routes allowing unauthenticated modification of templates or static webroot assets.
vectors.consequence: Public website defacement, destruction of corporate reputation, and immediate loss of commercial credibility.

vectors.name: LFI / RFI & SSRF
vectors.techDescription: Path traversal vulnerabilities in filesystem calls (fs.readFile) and unbounded remote fetch queries (fetch(req.query.url)).
vectors.consequence: Extraction of confidential server files (.env, /etc/passwd) and unauthorized querying of cloud metadata services (169.254.169.254).

vectors.name: Zero-Day Dynamic Code Execution
vectors.techDescription: Dynamic code evaluation patterns (eval(), new Function(), execSync(), and vulnerable prototype pollution vectors).
vectors.consequence: Immediate Remote Code Execution (RCE) granting attackers arbitrary command execution capability inside your backend runtime.

sandbox.title: Ephemeral Sandbox Processing
sandbox.description: Raw source code is extracted strictly to an isolated temporary sandbox directory. Once analysis finishes, the directory is immediately wiped from memory. Your proprietary code is never persisted, never indexed, and never used to train machine learning models.

items.question: How does ShipSafe differ from legacy scanners like Snyk or SonarQube?
items.answer: Traditional enterprise scanners are engineered for slow, monolithic waterfall development cycles and require extensive, fragile YAML configurations. ShipSafe is designed specifically for the AI vibe-coding era: instant 3-second in-memory AST scans, targeted focus on modern LLM hallucination risks (exposed secrets, missing database RLS, and prompt injection surfaces), and direct 1-click remediation prompts ready to paste back into Cursor, Claude Code, or Windsurf.

items.question: Do you upload or store my proprietary source code?
items.answer: Never. ShipSafe strictly enforces an ephemeral Zero-Persistence architecture. ZIP archives are extracted exclusively to an isolated temporary sandbox directory in RAM, analyzed by our deterministic AST engine, and immediately purged upon completion. We never index your code, never retain repository files, and never use user submissions to train machine learning models.

items.question: How do I connect ShipSafe to Cursor or Claude Desktop via MCP?
items.answer: ShipSafe provides an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server package (@lankdev/shipsafe-mcp) communicating over standard stdio JSON-RPC 2.0. Simply add our package to your editor config file (.cursor/mcp.json or claude_desktop_config.json). Once enabled, your AI coding agent can autonomously invoke audit_codebase, read the threat matrix, and apply patches in an automated self-healing loop.

items.question: Can ShipSafe run completely offline in an air-gapped terminal environment?
items.answer: Yes. By executing our lightweight terminal CLI (npx @lankdev/shipsafe-cli scan .), directory parsing and .gitignore evaluation happen entirely on your workstation. When pointed to a local or self-hosted instance of the ShipSafe backend engine, your codebase never leaves your local network, making it compliant with air-gapped enterprise environments.

items.question: What happens if a false positive or non-applicable rule is reported?
items.answer: Every vulnerability finding is tagged with an objective confidence level (Confirmed, Likely verify, or Not enough information) accompanied by an explicit verification command (such as npm audit or a test curl probe). If an identified pattern represents an intended architectural choice in your project, you can safely disregard it or adjust severity thresholds without interrupting your deployment pipeline.

header.title: 10 Vektor Ancaman Kritis yang Diaudit
header.subtitle: ShipSafe memeriksa seluruh permukaan kode yang dihasilkan AI terhadap 10 celah keamanan paling berisiko tinggi dalam arsitektur web modern:

vectors.name: SQL Injection
vectors.techDescription: Konkatenasi string SQL mentah dan interpolasi template literal tanpa sanitasi pada query basis data dan ORM.
vectors.consequence: Pengambilalihan penuh basis data, pencurian data pelanggan massal, dan kebocoran informasi sensitif perusahaan.

vectors.name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
vectors.techDescription: Injeksi HTML tanpa sanitasi melalui innerHTML, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, atau pemanggilan document.write.
vectors.consequence: Pembajakan token sesi pengguna, pengambilalihan akun secara ilegal, dan eksekusi skrip jahat pada browser korban.

vectors.name: DDoS & ReDoS
vectors.techDescription: Endpoint publik tanpa middleware rate limiter serta penggunaan ekspresi reguler (regex) rentan bencana backtracking eksponensial.
vectors.consequence: Server tumbang (downtime), lonjakan tagihan komputasi cloud tak terkendali, dan lumpuhnya layanan akibat kuota API habis.

vectors.name: Brute Force & Timing Attacks
vectors.techDescription: Pembandingan string password atau token rahasia secara langsung tanpa proteksi pembanding waktu konstan (crypto.timingSafeEqual).
vectors.consequence: Penebakan kunci rahasia melalui analisis waktu respon (side-channel) serta pembobolan login via serangan brute force otomatis.

vectors.name: Malware & Upload Web Shells
vectors.techDescription: Unggahan berkas tanpa validasi tipe MIME dan ekstensi yang memungkinkan penanaman skrip web shell (PHP/Node/JSP).
vectors.consequence: Pengambilalihan server secara menyeluruh, penanaman backdoor permanen, dan eksploitasi hak akses root oleh penyerang.

vectors.name: MitM & Broken TLS
vectors.techDescription: Konfigurasi TLS cacat seperti rejectUnauthorized: false, pengiriman kredensial HTTP tanpa enkripsi, dan ketiadaan flag cookie Secure/HttpOnly.
vectors.consequence: Penyadapan lalu lintas jaringan (MitM), pencurian token autentikasi di jaringan Wi-Fi publik, dan pemalsuan identitas sesi.

vectors.name: Phishing & Open Redirect
vectors.techDescription: Pengalihan tautan URL eksternal tanpa validasi (open redirect) serta absennya header pelindung clickjacking (X-Frame-Options/CSP).
vectors.consequence: Domain resmi Anda disalahgunakan sebagai sarana penipuan phising dan manipulasi antarmuka untuk mencuri kredensial pengguna.

vectors.name: Defacement Risks
vectors.techDescription: Endpoint administrasi atau rute CMS publik yang terbuka tanpa otorisasi, memungkinkan modifikasi template atau berkas webroot statis.
vectors.consequence: Perusakan visual halaman situs utama (deface), kehancuran reputasi bisnis secara instan, dan runtuhnya kepercayaan pelanggan.

vectors.name: LFI / RFI & SSRF
vectors.techDescription: Path traversal pada pemanggilan sistem berkas lokal (fs.readFile) dan permintaan HTTP keluar tanpa filter batasan (fetch(req.query.url)).
vectors.consequence: Pembacaan berkas rahasia server (.env, /etc/passwd) serta eksfiltrasi kredensial internal layanan metadata cloud instance (169.254.169.254).

vectors.name: Zero-Day Dynamic Code Execution
vectors.techDescription: Pola eksekusi kode dinamis berbahaya (eval(), new Function(), execSync(), serta celah prototype pollution).
vectors.consequence: Eksekusi kode jarak jauh (Remote Code Execution / RCE) seketika yang memberikan kendali eksekusi instruksi arbitrary pada runtime server.

sandbox.description: Kode sumber diekstrak secara ketat ke dalam direktori sandbox RAM sementara yang terisolasi. Begitu analisis tuntas, direktori tersebut langsung dihapus seketika dari sistem. Kode Anda tidak pernah disimpan permanen, tidak pernah diindeks, dan tidak pernah digunakan untuk melatih model AI.

items.question: Bagaimana cara menghubungkan ShipSafe ke Cursor atau Claude Desktop menggunakan MCP?
items.answer: ShipSafe menyediakan paket resmi Model Context Protocol (MCP) @lankdev/shipsafe-mcp yang beroperasi melalui standar stdio JSON-RPC 2.0. Anda cukup menyalin blok konfigurasi ke berkas editor Anda (.cursor/mcp.json atau claude_desktop_config.json). Setelah aktif, agen AI Anda dapat langsung menjalankan perintah audit_codebase, membaca matriks ancaman, dan memperbaiki kerentanan secara otonom.

items.question: Dapatkah ShipSafe dijalankan secara offline di komputer lokal atau lingkungan tertutup?
items.answer: Ya. Dengan menjalankan CLI terminal kami (npx @lankdev/shipsafe-cli scan .), proses pemindaian direktori dan evaluasi .gitignore berjalan sepenuhnya di komputer Anda. Ketika diarahkan ke instance backend lokal atau self-hosted kami, kode Anda tidak pernah keluar dari jaringan internal, sehingga sangat aman untuk lingkungan korporat tertutup (air-gapped).

items.question: Bagaimana jika ada temuan yang merupakan false positive atau tidak relevan dengan proyek saya?
items.answer: Setiap temuan dilengkapi dengan tingkat keyakinan objektif (Confirmed, Likely verify, atau Not enough information) serta perintah verifikasi mandiri (seperti npm audit atau pengujian curl). Jika temuan tersebut memang merupakan keputusan arsitektur yang disengaja dalam proyek Anda, Anda dapat mengabaikannya secara aman atau menyesuaikan ambang batas toleransi tanpa memutus pipeline deployment.
